correctness.rationale: For finite connected undirected weighted graphs with reciprocal positive edge weights, alpha_i in (0,1), common platform beta in [0,1), and full Friedkin–Johnsen peer relaxation between exact prediction updates, P=(I-Lambda W)^-1(I-Lambda) is stochastic and strictly positive. With mu_i=d_i/alpha_i the substochastic Q=Lambda W is reversible; resolvent R=(I-Q)^-1 is mu-positive definite and nu_i proportional to mu_i(1-alpha_i) makes P reversible strictly positive definite. Therefore P eigenvalues satisfy 1=lambda1>lambda2>=...>0, and f_beta(lambda)=(1-beta)lambda/(1-beta lambda) contracts every nonconstant nu-centered component strictly as beta rises. The lambda2 squared factor is sharp. In a two-vertex quotient the uniform difference always contracts. An independently reconstructed exact rational three-vertex path with alpha=(1/10,1/100,19/20), x=(0,1/4,1) has uniform variance 8163/819200 at beta=0, 4179945336867/419399996328968 at beta=1/20, and positive initial derivative 36441/458752000. This verifies smallest-order obstruction while no empirical or directed-graph conclusion is claimed.
